subject: Welcome to Tremor
html:
Tremor

{{GREETING}}

Thanks for signing up. Tremor watches public records about cancer drug trials and the companies running them, and emails you when something changes that could matter before big news comes out. You're all set: there's nothing else to do, and you won't need to sign in again.

What you'll get

Right away: an email when something big happens to a trial or company you follow, like a trial stopping or its main goal changing. You'll also hear about the very biggest events on any trial Tremor tracks, like a trial being stopped or a worry score turning red.

Once a day: smaller changes to what you follow, plus reminders about a month and a week before an FDA decision or expected trial results.

Quiet days: you only get an email when something actually happens, so many days there's nothing.

Get started

Find trials to follow
Tap the star on any trial or company.

See what's coming up
FDA decisions and trial results expected soon.

New to biotech stocks?
A 2-minute guide to how they move.

How the worry score works
Every rule, written simply.

You can choose which emails you get in your alert settings.

Not investment advice. Tremor shows what changed in public records and never tells anyone to buy or sell. Many trial edits turn out to be harmless.
